don’t usually leave 1-star reviews, but this is the worst GP surgery I’ve ever dealt with. Getting an appointment is nearly impossible unless you call the second they open and press 1 repeatedly. Even then, you’re often 15th in the queue, only to be told all slots are gone — “we’ve already booked 100 today.”  We are unable to book appointments for a different day. So you need to take a day off only to be told there is no appointments left.

You’re left to explain your own symptoms and being doctor for yourself sometimes. When you do they say it's normal and many people leave with those symptoms. They don't send you for more important checkup, blood tests etc when you call with the same problem over some period of time.

For a 15-minute adoption medical, we were charged £80 per person and were even handed another patient’s file (our neighbour’s) — serious data protection breach. But when they need money, they will call you non stop.

We’ve been waiting over a month for a simple Aviva form to be filled in. The person in charge is always off sick, on holiday, or never on the same shift. They are explaining that there is a backlog, as per usual.
